name: weeek-mcp-smart
description: WEEEK tasks and CRM by name, not IDs — an MCP server covering the whole public API
long_description: The only one-click WEEEK MCP server. Create, update, move, and complete WEEEK tasks by passing plain names — project, column, and assignee — instead of hunting down IDs first. Natural-language due dates ("next friday"), a guarded file-attach tool, and a confirm-gated delete. Tools come in five toolsets: tasks by default (including reading and setting custom-field values by name), plus time, projects and custom-fields (which administers the fields and their options), and crm (funnels, deals, organizations, contacts — every reference by name), enabled through WEEEK_TOOLSETS.

weeek_api_token.title: WEEEK API Token
weeek_api_token.description: Create one at WEEEK → Settings → API

weeek_toolsets.title: Toolsets
weeek_toolsets.description: Comma-separated tool groups to expose: tasks (default), time, projects, custom-fields, crm — or all
